CustomField.description: Multi-select picklist driving which addresses the confirmation-email Flow sends to. Values (Email, Email (Company), Alternate Contact) are matched with Contains in the Send Email overridable Flow against the converted submission's contacts. Requires Send Confirmation Email enabled.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Select which email fields on the submission should receive the confirmation email, such as Email, Email (Company), or Alternate Contact. This applies only when Send Confirmation Email is enabled.
CustomField.label: Recipients (Confirmation Email)
